title: Scale constants of the final English blend: sd of the base score U over held-out TRAIN pairs (SAFE-04 v4 cells), mean of 3 seed replicates

origin.basis: statistic of the 'dumpv4 <cell> <replicate> ... sd_all' log line of Experiment/FUSENET-01/run.py (FUSENET_MODE=dumpv4, run FLAG_219); constants typed by hand in the original work

verify.rule: FF_MODE=assemble: enforced by the stage itself (dp_sigma.py --strict by default, plus the table sha256 9f0a5af4...); modes train / infer: a rebuilt table may move the 4th decimal, reported (WARN); final_blend keeps the pinned XJF_SIG

env_spec: docker/requirements-dp-local.txt (team CPU machine: Python 3.14.0, torch 2.12.1+cpu, numpy 2.3.5, pandas 3.0.5, insightface 2.0, onnxruntime 1.31.1, speechbrain 1.1.2; S8 E3)

env_overrides.DP_SIGMA_DUMP: path of xjfdump_v4.parquet (else the FLAG_219 output mount, else the stored copies of mode (c))
env_overrides.DP_SIGMA_STRICT: 1 = stop on a mismatch, 0 = report; default 1 in FF_MODE=assemble, 0 otherwise

stored_inputs_mode_c: when the FLAG_219 output is not mounted (mode (c): soft input; FF_USE_SAVED=collected / none exclude the checkpoint class), the table is read from <FF_DATA entry>/05_scores/xjfdump_v4.parquet (flat layout of DESIGN 5.3), <FF_DATA entry>/03_checkpoints/sigma_source/**, or assembly/inputs/xjfdump_v4.parquet
